title: Checkout Form
description: The address and payment steps of a checkout, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Field, RadioGroup, Switch, Divider, Button and Alert primitives: a serif heading over a bordered form whose `step` picks what it asks for — shipping (an email for the receipt, the shipping address and a delivery method picked from bordered options with their price) or payment (the name on the card, its number, expiry and CVC, and a switch to save the card) — with back and continue buttons and its own disabled, loading and error renders; responds to its container (@container) — the fields pair off and the buttons share a row at @sm, the heading steps up and the delivery options sit side by side at @md, and each group's title moves beside its fields with more room above and below at @lg.
